description: This file defines the EmployeeMembershipModel class that represents the data structure and serialization logic for employee membership information within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It implements the Normalizable interface and uses traits for model serialization, mapping the EmployeeMembership entity's data to an API schema.

classes.name: EmployeeMembershipModel
classes.description: A model class that serializes EmployeeMembership entity data into a structured API response format following the specified schema, including properties like membership details, fees, dates, and related currency information.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with an EmployeeMembership entity and sets up property filters and attribute mappings for serialization.
